heading: Contact The Pet Studio
subheading: Whether you are booking a grooming appointment or exploring professional dog grooming training, we would love to hear from you.
intro_text:
Every dog is different, so we take the time to understand their breed, coat, age, temperament and grooming history before arranging an appointment. Calling the salon allows us to ask the right questions, recommend the most suitable service and make sure we allow enough time for your dog’s individual needs.

Please let us know if your dog is a puppy, elderly, nervous, has previously struggled with grooming or has any medical or behavioural information that may help us prepare. The more we know in advance, the better we can make the experience for your dog.
academy_section_intro:
Choosing the right course is an important decision, particularly if you are considering a career change or hoping to start a dog grooming business of your own.

Complete the enquiry form and tell us a little about your experience, your goals and the course you are interested in. You will receive an email with the next steps and a link to arrange a conversation with Liza. This gives you the opportunity to ask questions, understand what the training involves and decide whether the course is the right fit before making any commitment.
academy_intro: Tell us a little about yourself and what you would like to achieve. Liza will then be able to give you clear, personalised guidance on the most suitable course and your next steps.
success_message: Thank you for getting in touch. Please check your inbox for an email explaining the next steps and how to arrange a conversation with Liza.
message_placeholder: Please tell us which course interests you, whether you have any previous grooming experience and what you hope to achieve.
privacy_text: We will only use your details to respond to your enquiry. Please see our Privacy Policy for more information.
